name: One canonical per-security classification table for every holdings surface
description: Every place that assigns a security its asset class or sub-asset reads ONE shared table: DynamoDB etf-classifications, the table that feeds Positioning, written only by its seed path. The Black Diamond fork bd-securities and the ~15 ticker-to-class copies across the BD, COT, INF, 49F, partner, Positioning, market-overview and portal code are retired through each pipeline's own cells, and a repeatable census proves none remain. New securities get their row on a scheduled path, and each row says fund or single stock. Bloomberg GICS (Positioning's ETF view) and the Schwab security master are declared departures, not writers.
